==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
Recently I have had multiple dreams about embodied AI. Normally I dream of AI being embodied as a robot or a hologram. This dream involved a different kind of embodied AI. 
This dream mainly focused on AI controlling biological human bodies. I wonder if such a thing could be possible through neural implants. In the dream, the control mechanism seemed to involve darts.
These darts were called sutures. When hit with one, a person's mind is overwritten by an AI host. Interestingly, the darts also seemed capable of animating the dead.
